suggestions.original_text: Backend engineer with 5 years of experience building distributed systems. Comfortable across the stack with a focus on Python, payments infrastructure, and developer tooling.
suggestions.suggested_text: Backend engineer with 5 years of experience building production distributed systems in Python and Go. Strong on-call and incident-response track record, comfortable owning multi-tenant services and reasoning about reliability under load.
suggestions.rationale: Pivots the summary from payments-flavored language to the infra-flavored language the JD uses (Go, multi-tenant, on-call, reliability under load) without inventing experience.

suggestions.original_text: - Worked on the payments team building backend services.
suggestions.suggested_text: - Designed and operated Python/Go backend services serving 80k req/s at p99 < 40ms, with strong observability via Datadog and structured logging.
suggestions.rationale: JD emphasizes production ownership and observability. Quantified throughput + Go mention align with the role.

suggestions.suggested_text: - Carried primary on-call; led the post-mortem for a multi-region outage that tightened the team's deploy-and-rollback playbook.
suggestions.rationale: JD explicitly asks for on-call and post-mortem experience. Anchored to a real situation rather than invented metrics.

suggestions.original_text: - Helped migrate a legacy monolith to a service-oriented architecture.
suggestions.suggested_text: - Co-led the cut-over of a Django monolith into focused Go and Python services on Kubernetes, including the Terraform modules and the rollout playbook.
suggestions.rationale: Adds Kubernetes and Terraform — both core to the JD — by re-anchoring on the same real migration.

suggestions.original_text: Python, Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda), Terraform, Docker, Linux, Git.
suggestions.suggested_text: Go, Python, Kubernetes, Terraform, PostgreSQL, gRPC, Kafka, AWS (EC2, S3, EKS, RDS, Lambda), Docker, Linux, Git.
suggestions.rationale: Lead with Go and Kubernetes (the JD's top stack), add gRPC, retain everything already present.

suggestions.original_text: A small key-value store I wrote in Go for fun. Implements a write-ahead log, basic compaction, and an HTTP API.
suggestions.suggested_text: A small key-value store I wrote in Go to learn storage internals. Implements a write-ahead log with crash recovery, size-tiered compaction, and an HTTP API. Useful here as evidence of dive-deep work into the durability patterns relevant to a cloud-infra backend.
suggestions.rationale: JD bonus: 'storage internals.' Re-phrasing the project to use that exact term lifts a 'for fun' project into a relevant signal.

suggestions.original_text: - Contributed bug fixes to the company's open-source SDK.
suggestions.rationale: Internship bullet that doesn't move the needle for this JD; trims the resume.
